title: Chapter 189 People From The Hades Palace
content:
Chapter 189 People From The Hades Palace

On the other side.

Seeing Yan Lingyun safely crossing the Immortal Sect, Lu Daosheng also slowly headed towards the Immortal Sect.

Buzz —

At this moment, the immortal sect, which had already been silent and gradually faded, suddenly exuded a terrifying pressure.

Obviously, the Immortal Sect is not welcome to Lu Daosheng.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng was not used to it.

boom!

With a loud bang, the entire immortal sect was directly penetrated.

"Stop me? Hoho."

Lu Daosheng chuckled and then stepped in slowly.

This time, the Immortal Sect no longer had the intention to block it and let Lu Daosheng enter.

Somewhere in the fairy world.

Yan Lingyun stood there, as if she was waiting for something.

And at this time, an abnormal movement came from behind.

The space cracked and Yan Lingyun immediately smiled when she saw the visitor.

"What's next? You said."

Looking at Lu Daosheng, Yan Lingyun spoke.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng looked at the surrounding environment and was stunned, "Is the flow rate of time really different?"

Then Lu Daosheng laughed and said, "Let's go, I'll take you to see someone."

.........

at the same time.

Wood Fairy Realm, Spiritual Realm.

In recent years, a huge monster suddenly appeared here.

The deserted city.

Nowadays, after years of development, the strength of Huangcheng is increasing day by day.

A few years ago, the strong man in Huangcheng defeated the Sect Master of the Immortal Sword Sect with one move and was completely famous in the Wood Fairy World, with a position above the six major immortal forces.

People thought that the deserted city would develop peacefully, but unexpectedly, the deserted city was like a naughty man, still developing wildly, squanderingly, and arrogant.

Some powerful people speculate that the deserted city will offend some terrifying existences and encounter a catastrophe.

In the spiritual world, the deserted city.

"Mr. Wan, Qingyu is willing to join our wasteland city."

A figure spoke respectfully.

Upon hearing this, Wanfeng nodded, "Continue to expand."

There was no hesitation in the figure in front of him, "Yes, sir."

He has become accustomed to the words to continue to expand.

At the beginning, he did feel fear and worry, but now, he found that this deserted city is not simple, especially the adult in front of him, whose strength is even more terrifying.

Facing the leader of the Immortal Sword Sect who is famous in the fairy world, this lord defeated the other party with just one move.

That's a powerful person in the Immortal Emperor Realm!

There is no doubt that the master I followed was also a powerful Immortal Emperor Realm, and he was not an ordinary Immortal Emperor Realm.

So since then, he has become more loyal.

The most important thing is that the person in front of him is not only strong, but also rich.

Following this kind of person, there is a bright future.

"By the way, sir, can you ask a question?"

At this time, in front of Wan Feng, Xun Heng suddenly spoke.

Hearing this, Wan Feng glanced at Xun Heng and nodded, "Ask."

"Sir, what the villain wants to ask is that you built this deserted city. Why do you never let us call you the city lord? Is there anyone else in the city lord?"

Xun Heng slowly expressed his questions.

Hearing this, Wanfeng smiled.

"You're pretty smart."

"Yes, the lord of Huangcheng is indeed someone else. I am actually just a job like you."

Working. .

After hearing this answer, Xun Heng was shocked.

If the terrifying existence in the Immortal Emperor realm is working, then that city lord is so awesome.

For a moment, Xun Heng suddenly began to look forward to it.

And at this moment, a terrifying vibration suddenly came from the outside world.

Boom!

Suddenly, the entire deserted city became panic.

The Immortal Emperor Realm is a strong man in the Immortal Emperor Realm!

When he noticed the movement, Wan Feng frowned slightly, and flashed, and came outside the deserted city.

At this time, a middle-aged man in black was standing faintly in the void.

"You are the master of this wasteland city?"

Seeing Anhui Feng, the middle-aged man spoke coldly.

"You are from the Nether Palace."

Wan Feng did not answer the other party, but directly revealed the other party's origin.

Suddenly, the middle-aged man was shocked.

"You actually know my Nether Palace?!"

Upon hearing this, Wanfeng laughed directly.

"If your ancestors of the Nether Palace knew that you were coming to find me, they would probably be so angry that they would crawl out of the coffin."

The Palace of the Underworld is one of the nine major forces that jointly sealed Anhui Feng.

During that battle, the ancestor of the Nether Palace was seriously injured and soon he sat in the Nether Palace.

However, although the death of the ancestor of the Nether Palace caused the strength of the Nether Palace to decline, the Nether Palace did not remain silent, but miraculously survived.

Nowadays, it has become a special force in the Wood Immortal Realm.

On weekdays, only the top strong people know the horror of special forces.

Now, the crazy expansion of Huangcheng has obviously alarmed the interests of special forces.

Hearing Wan Feng's words, the middle-aged man finally realized something was wrong.

"Who are you?"

The middle-aged man did not recognize Wanfeng.

After all, the era in which Wanfeng was in that era has long passed, and most of the strong people who survived in that era have fallen or left this world and are still there. It is probably nothing big, and they will basically not come out.

This is also the reason why Wan Feng has not responded to the sealed incident that year.

But not doing it doesn't mean she doesn't care.

At this moment, the middle-aged man stared at Wan Feng in the distance, and his mind kept recalling.

And in the dark, countless strong men began to deduce frantically, but they got nothing.

"She is the Mad Emperor!"

At this moment, a figure rushed out from the dark, pointing at Wan Feng and yelling.

For a moment, everyone present had different expressions.

Some were shocked, some were confused, and some smiled bitterly.

"Mad Emperor, it's actually the Mad Emperor!"

One person suddenly exclaimed.

All of a sudden, everyone looked at him, "Do you know the Mad Emperor?"

The man shook his head, "I don't know."

"What about your name nm?!"

Looking at the angry eyes of the crowd, the man smiled awkwardly and quickly fled the scene.

At this time, the middle-aged man in the void murmured: "Are you the Mad Emperor?"

As a person from the Hades Palace, he naturally knew about the Mad Emperor.

But obviously he didn't know much, otherwise, he wouldn't be so calm.

Seeing Wan Feng nodded in agreement, the middle-aged man snorted coldly, "In that case, let's settle the old and new grudges together!"

Originally, he came here just to give Huang Cheng a verbal warning.

But now that he knows the identity of the Crazy Emperor, he will naturally take action.

According to his understanding of the Crazy Emperor, the Crazy Emperor and his Nether Palace are enemies. As for the strength of the Crazy Emperor, he doesn't know much.

Seeing the middle-aged man rushing towards him, Wan Feng was slightly stunned.

The other party knew her identity, but he dared to go up.

After not seeing her for many years, is the Nether Palace so powerful?

At this time, the aura of the middle-aged man was completely exposed to everyone.

The fourth level of the Immortal Emperor Realm!

It turned out to be a strong man in the middle stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm, no wonder he is so confident.

You know, the leader of the Immortal Sword Sect is only the second level of the Immortal Emperor Realm.
